sources.title: Modular symmetries and the swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Determine the modular covariance of the superpotential from the Kähler transformation, represent the allowed sections through modular forms, and analyze their cusp expansions and extrema.

sources.title: Brane annihilation in non-supersymmetric strings

evidence.text: Sphere reduction with a dynamical radion produces a lower-dimensional Einstein-frame vacuum energy. Euclidean thin-wall instantons compare bubble area and enclosed-volume contributions to B in Γ/Vol∼(det)e^(−B).

sources.title: Brane-Jet Instabilities

evidence.text: Imported uplift formulae construct the metric and warp factor from the E7(7)/SU(8) scalar 56-bein and ambient S7 scalar harmonics. A cubic-invariant construction reduces Δ^−3 to a homogeneous quartic polynomial in those harmonics, enabling numerical extrema searches.

sources.title: The non-SUSY AdS$_{6}$ and AdS$_{7}$ fixed points are brane-jet unstable

evidence.text: Applies existing consistent uplift formulae to obtain warped metrics and higher-dimensional fluxes. At fixed points, integrates the six-form or seven-form flux to construct the D4 or M5 Wess–Zumino potential using constant scalars and A = r/l.

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric AdS$_{6}$ and the swampland

evidence.text: Reduce the curve equations using the ϕ isometry and a constant-radius ansatz, then test internal and radial stationarity against the full action. The source's proposed reduction is not verified by its printed coefficients.

sources.title: Bubble instability of mIIA on $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^6$

evidence.text: Derives a one-dimensional effective action and supplements its equations with the rr Einstein equation, interpreted as zero radial Hamiltonian. The authors report equivalence with the ten-dimensional equations evaluated on their ansatz.
